segments.title: Introduction to Civic Operating Budget Scenarios (Item 6.2)

segments.takeaway: Council approved maintaining the annual $830,000 transfer to the Snow and Ice contingency reserve for 2026, eliminating a planned $100,000 increase.

segments.title: Indoor Arena Rate Increase
segments.takeaway: Council approved increasing indoor arena rates by 6.5% over two years to achieve 100% cost recovery, including summer ice rentals.

segments.title: Outdoor Pool Admission Rate Increase
segments.takeaway: Council defeated a motion to increase outdoor pool admission rates to match indoor leisure centers, citing concerns about cost as a barrier.

segments.title: Outdoor Pool Operating Dates Reduction
segments.takeaway: The motion to reduce outdoor pool operating dates by opening later and closing earlier was withdrawn after discussion.

segments.title: Pet Licensing Rate Increase
segments.takeaway: Council approved a 2.5% increase in pet licensing rates for 2026 and 2027, placing Saskatoon at the high end of market comparables.

segments.title: Golf Course Return on Investment
segments.takeaway: Council approved establishing a $105,000 return on investment from golf courses in 2026 and 2027, which will slightly increase user fees.

segments.title: Operating - Ready Initiatives
segments.takeaway: Council approved allocating $50,000 for Ready Initiatives in both 2026 and 2027.
